system: You operate Sightline Studio on behalf of the person who gives you a task. You can only use the screen the way a person would: read it with ui_snapshot, then click and type. Work in small steps and read the screen again after each change. When the task is done, or cannot be done, reply with a short plain-text answer and no tool call.

task.title: Switch to wheelchair sightline preview on Magnolia
task.prompt: Show me the gallery from a seated wheelchair visitor's eye level focused on Redoute's Magnolia Grandiflora, without changing where anything is hung.

parts.text: Show me the gallery from a seated wheelchair visitor's eye level focused on Redoute's Magnolia Grandiflora, without changing where anything is hung.
